records.name: help-root-agent-0-width-40
records.stdout:
cron-person is a higher-order crontab
manager that executes cron tasks in
their respective directory contexts with
direnv-style allow/deny authorization.

Usage:
  cron-person [flags] [command]

Available Commands:
├─ allow [path]
│      Authorize .cronrc in the
│      specified directory
├─ crontab
│      Synchronize and inspect system
│      crontab integration
│  ├─ show
│  │      Preview generated crontab
│  │      block without modifying
│  │      crontab
│  ├─ sync
│  │      Compile authorized directory
│  │      jobs and install into user
│  │      crontab
│  ╰─ uninstall
│         Remove cron-person managed
│         block from system crontab
├─ dashboard
│      Serve the bundled local CRUD
│      dashboard
├─ deny [path]
│      Revoke authorization for the
│      specified directory
├─ dir
│      Inspect and manage directory
│      authorizations and .cronrc
│      configurations
│  ├─ allow [path]
│  │      Authorize .cronrc in the
│  │      specified directory
│  ├─ check [path]
│  │      Validate syntax and
│  │      parseability of a .cronrc file
│  ├─ deny [path]
│  │      Revoke authorization for the
│  │      specified directory
│  ╰─ status [path]
│         Show status and tasks for a
│         specific directory
├─ exec <dir> [--] <command...>
│      Execute a command in an
│      authorized directory with cwd and
│      .cronrc environment
├─ hook <bash|zsh|fish>
│      Generate shell integration hook
│      script
├─ status
│      Display overall system status and
│      every tracked directory
╰─ task
       Inspect and trigger scheduled
       tasks
   ├─ history [dir]
   │      List recent task runs, newest
   │      first
   ├─ list
   │      List all tasks defined across
   │      all authorized directories
   ├─ log <run-id>
   │      Show the details and captured
   │      output of a task run
   ╰─ run <dir> <command...>
          Manually execute a task inside
          a target directory with its
          .cronrc environment

Environment Variables:
  AGENT
    Set to 1, true, or yes for compact
    agent-mode output
  XDG_STATE_HOME
    Base directory for the default store
    and run history
  XDG_CONFIG_HOME
    Base directory for the default
    configuration file
  SHELL
    Shell that runs tasks when .cronrc
    does not set SHELL

Flags:
      --config string
        Path to custom configuration
        file (default:
        $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/cron-person/config.json)
  -h, --help
        help for cron-person
      --store string
        Path to custom authorization
        state file (default:
        $XDG_STATE_HOME/cron-person/allowed.json)
  -v, --version
        version for cron-person

Use "cron-person [command] --help" for
more information about a command.
